description: Synthetic dots.json, written by `python3 tools/dots.py init` on one machine (the optional `watch` delays below are the one key an owner adds by hand). Dot ids, project ids, session ids, host labels and the wake command are invented; the wake command stands for whatever CLI the instance already has to post one line into a dot's chat. The shape is described in workflows/direct-mail.md; the file is optional and every command works without it.

hosts.label: vm
hosts.purpose: Dots VM: research, read-only analysis, derived work that does not change the canonical copy

hosts.label: local
hosts.purpose: This computer: canonical writes, the shared folder, long runs, logins, devices, native build

hosts.label: build-box
hosts.purpose: A second computer used only for native builds and signing

wake: [example-project-main -> {dot}] {agent}: mail {id} unread; wake it to read its inbox (dots.py wait {dot} {agent})
notify: [example-project-main -> {dot}] {agent}: mail {id} still unread {age} min after the wake
